epics.title: Pipeline Unblocking
epics.jtbd: When acting as the project manager, I want to safely unblock stalled reviews, so that the task pipeline can resume processing.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce tasks stuck in pending_review from 1 to 0
requirements: R1: Patch task state machine to unblock task 529e5252-040a-4889-9f61-366ea6e9e089 and prevent infinite review states.

slices.title: Patch pending_review timeout logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the state machine patch for this epic, I want to add a safe fallback transition, so that the task pipeline unblocking is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given task 529e5252-040a-4889-9f61-366ea6e9e089 is stuck in pending_review, When the unblock patch executes, Then the task transitions out of pending_review.
Given queued idle tasks, When the blocking task is cleared, Then the queued tasks start processing.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease time-in-pending_review for stalled tasks to a fixed maximum

epics.title: Stagnation Resolution
epics.jtbd: When managing task execution, I want to fix the underlying stagnation defect, so that task resolutions increase and falsification readiness exceeds 90%.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase falsification readiness threshold from <90% to >90%
requirements: R1: Patch the execution loop to correctly process decomposed tasks and update status counts.

slices.title: Patch task dispatch loop
slices.jtbd: When implementing the dispatch fix for this epic, I want to patch the task processing loop, so that the stagnation resolution is achieved and tasks progress.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given task status counts frozen at 0 resolutions, When the patched execution loop runs, Then tasks progress and status counts increment.
Given an updated task state, When falsification readiness is calculated, Then it reaches the required 90% threshold.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase task resolutions per cycle from 0 to >0
